select finprod_id as finprodId, finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr from FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 and FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01'
AND (finprod_id like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR finprod_abbr like '%' || #{search} || '%')
GROUP BY finprod_id, finprod_abbr

SELECT vfp.finprod_market_id as bondid, vfp.finprod_abbr as bondname, vfp.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, to_char(vfp.vdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') as vdate1, to_char(vfp.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') as mdate1, vfp.coupon_species as couponType, vfp.coupon_species as couponTypeCode, fpt.type_1 as bondtype, fpt.type_1 as bondtypeCode, (fccr.yield)*100 as rate, fccr2.basis as basis, vfp.ISSUE_PRICE as price, vfp.finprod_name as finprodName, vfp.finprod_id as finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT vfp left join (select * from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr where 1 = 1 and fccr.eff_date = (select max(a.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a where a.finprod_id = fccr.finprod_id and a.finprod_type = a.finprod_type)) fccr on vfp.finprod_id = fccr.finprod_id and vfp.finprod_type = fccr.finprod_type left join (select * from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr2 where 1 = 1 and fccr2.eff_date = (select min(a.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a where a.finprod_id = fccr2.finprod_id and a.finprod_type = a.finprod_type)) fccr2 on vfp.finprod_id = fccr2.finprod_id and vfp.finprod_type = fccr2.finprod_type left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id where vfp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01'
AND vfp.finprod_id in
#{bond}
AND vfp.coupon_species in
#{couponType}
AND fpt.type_1 in
#{bondType}
AND vfp.vdate >= to_date(#{vDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND vfp.vdate <=to_date(#{vDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND vfp.mdate >=to_date(#{mDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND vfp.mdate <= to_date(#{mDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY vfp.finprod_market_id, vfp.finprod_abbr, vfp.FINPROD_TYPE, vfp.vdate, vfp.mdate, vfp.coupon_species, fpt.type_1, fccr.yield, fccr2.basis, vfp.ISSUE_PRICE, vfp.finprod_name, vfp.finprod_id

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK mark, ( SELECT MAX(mark.HIS_NO) his_no, mark.WORKFLOW_ID FROM SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK mark WHERE mark.BUSINESS_DATA_PK1 = #{businessDataPk1} GROUP BY mark.WORKFLOW_ID ) maxmark WHERE maxmark.his_no = mark.his_no AND maxmark.workflow_id = mark.workflow_id AND mark.status IN('A','U','P') AND mark.business_data_pk1 = #{businessDataPk1}
